status: x-y-time-only 500-m place × kinematic × same-night feasibility preflight frozen before vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory environmental-context mechanism test; cannot alter v0.3.8

context.night_rule: UTC timestamp shifted backward by 12 hours, then calendar date

feasibility.self_history: other retained sessions of the same individual in the same frozen cohort
feasibility.same_night_other: retained sessions assigned to the same shifted night from other individuals in the same cohort
feasibility.target_support: target endpoint whose 500-m cell×speed×turn stratum occurs in both self history and same-night-other history
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of the frozen 500-m baseline n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If all four panels pass, freeze exact n and open the 500-m same-night vertical comparison. Otherwise stop before vertical outcome.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.self_predictor: equal-session P(centered residual height | 500-m cell,state) from same individual's other sessions
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.contemporaneous_predictor: equal-individual P(centered residual height | 500-m cell,state) from other individuals on target shifted night
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.endpoint: mean target log P_self - log P_same_night_other on identical supported target endpoints
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.calibration: whole-session identity permutation within cohort while retaining session night, x-y-time state and centered z with the session block
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated excess >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 3 or 4 PASS => broad shared-night context remains insufficient even at 500-m spatial matching; 1 or 2 => mixed; 0 => shared night becomes a leading explanation subject to power.

claim_boundary: Same-night is a broad temporal-context proxy, not exact local weather.
500-m matching does not equal exact route or microclimate matching.
This extension is post-freeze and cannot alter v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change 500-m grid, night definition, purity, speed2_turn2 state, 70% gate, >=5 floor or 50-event support after preflight output.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes before all four panels pass the structural gate.
If the preflight fails, do not loosen support or revert to a coarser grid as rescue.
